decision: The entire one-file hunk assigns the modern disabled placeholder the existing disabled-trigger-text-color token inside mat-mdc-select-disabled. It does not edit the original legacy .mat-select color contract or the exported theme constructors. Keep the original16 legacy disabled placeholder/value/arrow and custom-map behavior; do not transplant the modern token-slot selector into the owned legacy Sass. Both exact peer npm floors already contain the modern disabled-placeholder structural rule, while the retained historical ordinary select-theme emits color tokens rather than that structural rule. Actual original16-versus-packed default/custom disabled placeholder, disabled value and invalid-arrow style probes pass. Modern select is outside the thirteen bridged companions; no current-component fork or claim that its full interaction/style contract was exercised is made. The retained execution receipts apply to their recorded historical subjects. Current qualification additionally requires the complete current clean same-library packed106 and Sass invocations, exact minimum peer identities and the required owned default/custom light/dark style assertions with effective custom-theme and wrong-style controls; this source review alone qualifies no current execution.
